name: Mirrored
source:
A young girl finds herself in a public bathroom. She doesn't know how she got there and she's covered in wounds.

Why doesn't she remember it? Why is she injured?

[From [url=https://despaircode777.itch.io/mirrored]Itch.io[/url]]

一名年轻女孩发现自己身处公共浴室。她不知道自己是怎么到那里的，浑身是伤。

为什么她不记得了？她为什么受伤？
